title: Deriving Bluebird B from S and K
description: Construct B = S(K(S))(K) using only the S and K combinators and verify its composition behavior.

steps.description: Define S and K, derive I_bird = S(K)(K), and construct the composition combinator B_from_SK = S(K(S))(K).

steps.question: When B_from_SK = S(K(S))(K) is applied to add_one, what does S(K(S))(K)(add_one) reduce to?
steps.answer: By the S rule, S(K(S))(K)(add_one) becomes K(S)(add_one)(K(add_one)), which simplifies to S(K(add_one)).

steps.description: Define add_one and double, then test B_from_SK(add_one)(double)(5) and B_from_SK(str)(double)(5).
Step through B_from_SK(add_one)(double)(5) to see the S and K rewrites compute add_one(double(5)) = 11.
